notes.title: Galaxy squad announcement!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! I am very happy to announce my new project, Galaxy squad! 
I've been working on it for quite a lot of time, and I'm ready to finally reveal it. 

Galaxy squad is turn-based tactical game, kinda like mix between XCOM and FTL! You are leading a group of characters across randomly generated galaxy, encounter different story events and fight in hardcore tactical battles.

Check out the announcement trailer:

http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4MVWPO1Dv4o

And check out steam store page for more info: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/921710/Galaxy_Squad/

Add it to your wishlists and share it with your friends! I am planning to release the game into Early Access at the end of the year! 

Also subscribe to my developer page to get more updates!

https://store.steampowered.com/curator/33429885/

notes.title: Unknown Pleasures: 10 lower-profile new Steam games
notes.content:
New feature! There are more new PC games released each week than any one human could realistically play, and while we try to zero in on the most interesting, many lovely things inevitably fall through the cracks. So here’s the deal: each week, I browse the teeming ranks of Steam (we’ll also be including itch.io a little later, incidentally) for ten likely prospects released within the past seven days. I play each for ten minutes, then decide whether or not I’d like to keep playing them. It’s not a review, but it is, but it isn’t, but maybe? In any case: new games for good people. That’s you, that is.

Update: this piece now includes (as it will every time henceforth) my Pick Of The Week from the ten games included.
… [visit site to read more]

notes.title: Early access version 0.5a
notes.content:
New update was just added to the game:

[list]
    [*]New dialogue with voice acting added. I've remade most of the story dialogue in the game, and added a lot of dumb jokes and movie/games references, which someone hopefuly find funny. Main hero is now occasionally will drop one-liner after killing an enemy
    [*]You can now choose arenas for survival. Right now there is 3 arenas: village, bunker and facility. All progress and achievements shared between arenas
    [*]Enemy models are now slightly larger and their hitboxes are easier to shoot.
   [*]Crosshairs for shotgun and grenade launcher are changed and main UI ingame is slightly smaller
[/list]

Full release plans:

I am planning to exit early access in a week or two. I almost finished final level, and it wll be available right after release. I'm afraid I can't add more content to the game in EA, I need to release it finally. I will try to fix all of the small bugs I have right now, before release. Thank you.

notes.title: Early access version 0.4a
notes.content:
A huge update:


[list]
    [*]Levels 7 and 8 of campaign are added. I decided to release levels 7 an 8 together. They are shorter by length than other levels I think, but have few new fun mechanics and enemies. I hope you will like it!
    [*]Controller support. I started to implement basic controller support. You can now rebind gamepad keys in Unity start menu, and choose gamepad control scheme in control options in main menu. Please post feedback, if you use a controller and I will improve support more. Gamepad controls in menu is coming later.
    [*]Game is now requires DirectX11
[/list]
